methodological_deviation: Design doc specified 'disagreement_fold decile x horizon'. Implemented instead as 'disagreement_fold decile x lookahead-window-membership' (pooling hour-ahead 19-24) because per-individual-horizon daytime sample counts beyond hour-ahead 19 are statistically unusable at this Arctic site (n=1 for horizons 20-24 in TRAIN+VAL). This is the coarsest defensible generalization of Mechanism A, disclosed here, not silently substituted.
